explorer.examples.host-concurrency.descr: A compact @shajara/host sketch where one RiteRoutine owns the orchestration, spawns sibling work, and joins the results before returning.
explorer.examples.host-concurrency.guide: The RiteRoutine itself is the parent orchestration scope.
spawn(...) starts child work that advances concurrently inside that scope.
wait(...) joins the child futures before the parent returns.
explorer.examples.host-concurrency.title: Host concurrency
